title: A Danish Christmas
overview: Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge and the two find a connection as well.

title: Trahisons, l'art de rompre en politique
Crimson Ring
overview: A young boxer risks everything by turning to performance-enhancing drugs before the biggest fight of his life.

title: History of the Marvel Universe Side-Scroll
overview: Enjoy a 10-hour musical, scrolling loop of Chris Giarrusso’s epic artwork from “History of the Marvel Universe.”

title: A Man of Vision: The Bill Wittliff Story
overview: From a small-town Texas boy to the visionary behind Lonesome Dove, Bill Wittliff spent a lifetime capturing the soul of Texas through photography, film, and storytelling.

title: Scorcher
overview: Elaine, a young crowd canvasser, struggles to raise money for women’s reproductive healthcare on the hottest day of the summer. She’s on the brink of being fired and showing signs of heat exhaustion when a coworker approaches her about starting a canvassing union.

title: Target: Captain Black!
overview: Once, he was their most trusted agent. Now, they hunt him.

title: Wrapped in Christmas Memories
overview: Seeking a buyer for her family’s antique store this Christmas, tech guru Delphia butts heads with history buff Keenan, who wants to buy it. But when she discovers a mystery in the store’s famous Christmas Dollhouse, he’s the only one who can help her solve it.

title: The Holiday Spark
overview: Firefight Dean enlists illustrator Laura to help plan a holiday party for his firehouse. As they plan the epic party, both begin to question their views on romance and the possibility of love at first spark.

title: A Royal Christmas Switch
overview: When Prince Alexander of Belvaria crosses paths with Ethan, a small-town man who looks like his twin, they decide to swap places for the Christmas season so Alexander can finally experience a normal holiday.

title: Boyzone: One for the Road
overview: Against the backdrop of decades of personal history and the pressure of thousands of expectant fans, the band return carrying unresolved tensions and unfinished business from their final tour in 2019. This time, they want to go out on their own terms and have the send-off that they – and the fans – so badly want.

title: Godzilla Minus Zero
overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

title: Model Citizen
overview: With his memories gone and his past a blur, ex-cop Steven Bay seeks treatment for his amnesia while working on an isolated farm. Instead, he's met with rising hostility, strange surveillance, and instincts he can’t fully control. When the pressure becomes unbearable, Bay begins a desperate hunt for the truth behind his fractured reality.

title: Better Alone
overview: Overwhelmed by living with their teenage children, Lidia and Félix announce a decision as unexpected as it is irreversible. A sharp comedy about family ties, the limits of cohabitation, and the difficult transition to adulthood.

title: Mike Tyson: Return of the Mike
overview: The former heavyweight champion returns to the stage for a raw one-man show, turning his wildest life stories into comedy gold at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino.

title: Ada
overview: Two sisters on a forgotten island, surrounded by a sea full of rubbish. They are waiting for Darko, the island's keeper: he brings food and is their last link to the world. Silence is their survival strategy. But on an island without rules, silence too comes at a price.

title: The Holiday Hitman
overview: Hitman Hank Carter is trying to save his marriage with the perfect family Christmas. Unfortunately for him, a hit has been put on his head — and a gang of festive bounty hunters will stop at nothing to collect the payday.

title: Kings of the Beach
overview: A documentary about the epic rise (and subsequent fall) of beach volleyball, featuring many of the boldfaced names from Southern California who helped popularize it.

title: Duct Tape
overview: Two boys are kidnapped and thrown into a room. How will they get out?

title: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
overview: When a medical emergency pulls the Goss family apart, determined dog Winstead will do all he can to bring his humans back together before Christmas Eve.

title: Ghost Soldier
overview: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

title: Overacting
overview: When her father's memories as a retired top cop resurface, a struggling actress stages wild missions to keep him from pursuing his elusive archnemesis.

title: Club Kid
overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

title: Ninho: Fame Ain’t Worth It
overview: At the height of his success in 2025, French rap star Ninho considers leaving music behind. This documentary looks back on the triumphs, sacrifices and personal challenges that brought him to that crossroads.

title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

title: The Last Temptation of Becky
overview: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

title: Women on Trial
overview: 1972. A landmark trial shakes France as young Marie-Claire is prosecuted for having an illegal abortion with the help of her mother and two other defendants. In a courtroom governed by men, the verdict seems inevitable: prison for the women, while the rapist goes unpunished. Their last hope lies with Gisèle Halimi, a fearless lawyer known for openly challenging patriarchy and confronting the system that condemns victims and lets perpetrators walk free. Alongside the accused, Gisèle will not only change their fate, but, against all odds, transform the condition of women forever

title: Final Interview
overview: Six college students meet at the final interview of a global IT company. Growing closer as they prepare for the group discussion, they dare to dream that all six might make it — until the day before the interview, when the company announces its verdict: only one will be hired. On the day of the interview, mysterious envelopes arrive, each containing one of their secrets — and suspicion begins to take hold. Who among the six is the liar?

title: Rammstein – Live in Mexico City
overview: A three-night compilation that captures their spectacular October 2022 shows at the Foro Sol Stadium in Mexico City during the Stadium Tour era. This live has become the band's most massive and longest one of their entire career.

title: The Table: Day and Night
overview: In a bustling café where lives briefly intersect, serendipity takes centre stage. A man and a woman share the same eccentric dream – will fate bring them together? Old classmates run into each other after years: a sweet second chance or a bitter reality check? A director approaches a novelist he admires to find out if the connection on page is merely delusional. A K-idol meets her first love, where the prospect of parting ways leaves them feeling wistful.

title: Living Book
overview: After losing his father, Roma lost his faith in goodness and became brash and rebellious. Together with a timid elementary school student, Vitya, they sneak into the house of a mysterious old man, where they find magical books with animated characters. Through carelessness, the boys unleash an evil sorcerer. To save his friend and restore everything to its rightful place, Roma must do the impossible: believe in himself again.

title: The Arab
overview: Haroun is an old bachelor who has lived in Oran for several years. A retired civil servant, he leads a reclusive life until the day he meets Kamel in a bar—a journalist to whom he tells an incredible story dating back to 1942. He claims to be the brother of ‘the Arab’ killed in a story told in one of the most famous novels of the 20th century, ‘The Stranger’ by Albert Camus. An Arab with an erased name: Moussa. Through anger, assertions, details, and confidences, Haroun finally convinces the journalist to listen to his story. His confession is a cry of freedom and distress—but above all, a cry of revolt: against an abusive mother, against a country that failed to achieve true independence, against a book, and against a famous French writer.

title: Small Spaces
overview: When an eccentric stranger promises to cure his claustrophobia, a sceptical man agrees to her treatment, only to discover that escaping his fear may cost him far more than living with it.

title: See You Tomorrow Tomorrow Tomorrow
overview: An aspiring, queer stand-up comedian grapples with her career and the greater duty of caring for her 99-year-old grandmother in her final years.

title: Let This Stay Between Us
overview: After becoming involved with his student, a university professor is torn between desire and professional ethics. Determined to safeguard their secret relationship, he puts his personal and professional stability on the line.

title: The Acres
overview: Christine enters The Acres estate with gardening tools and a plan, but then she encounters Ama, a lonely new mother. Ama reminds Christine of the early days of motherhood, a simpler time before things took a turn.

title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
overview: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

title: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
overview: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

title: Drummer Boy
overview: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family search for freedom. Through battle and loss, music carries hope in a deeply human story of faith and forgiveness.

title: Scene
overview: Inbaraj, a police officer, is forced to reopen a case he left unfinished years ago. This time, he must solve it with a chaotic and troublesome team. As they struggle to work together and deal with the twists and turns of the case, the investigation takes them on a chaotic and unpredictable ride.

title: Dilwali Diwali
overview: Ansh Sikkha returns to his Punjabi family home for Diwali after years working abroad. As the Sikkas gather for the festival, their clashing views on what constitutes a fulfilling life create friction and connection.

title: Frequency of Fear
overview: In September 2024, a covert Israeli operation took aim at decimating Islamist militant group Hezbollah, in which thousands of pagers and walkie-talkies in the possession of its operatives exploded simultaneously in Lebanon.

title: High End: The Watch Theft Ring
overview: Investigates Chile's high-profile Caso Relojes ("Watch Case") scandal, in which a suitcase full of smuggled luxury watches and jewelry unmasked an illicit underground network, connecting criminal elements to Chile's social elite.

title: Casa Pequena
overview: Five musicians travel to a secluded house in the Serra da Estrela mountains, hoping that a retreat will renew their friendship and creativity, but a mysterious host will place the band at the center of an intrigue. Is this house cursed?

title: Ferine
overview: A tragic event shatters a rich art collector's life, awakening her primal nature. She destroys her privileged existence to build a new concept of family, leading her on a path of destruction and animalistic transformation.

title: GJLS: Berapi-Api
overview: Three best friends are obsessed with becoming firefighters so they can look heroic by putting out fires. However, after failing during their training with the legendary Algojo Api squad, the three find themselves stuck doing seemingly “trivial” assignments. When they attempt to take a shortcut to join the firefighting team as soon as possible, they instead find themselves caught up in a dangerous mission to rescue children from a criminal syndicate.

title: Ghost Song
overview: Farasha and Faris are 20 when they meet at a graduation party – one glance that changes everything. But Farasha dies that very same night. Refusing to be separated from him, she discovers a way to cross the boundary between worlds: for 40 nights, and 40 nights only, she can meet Faris in his dreams. And so their love continues to grow, until the very last night.

title: Santa's Workshop
overview: Nine-year-old Mari is really looking forward to Christmas. Her journalist dad, Svein, on the other hand, loves his job so much, he barely notices the festive season. One night, Mari’s Christmas list vanishes – and in its place lies a mysterious mitten. The mitten sends Mari, Svein and her adventurous grandma on an exciting quest to find Santa Claus. Meanwhile, Stubby the Wishlist Elf is in a panic — he’s lost his mitten, which might just lead this curious family straight to the secret location of Santa’s workshop! He must stop them before it’s too late!

title: Terrell & T.O.
overview: This feature-length documentary traces the meteoric rise of one of the most talented, accomplished, and polarizing athletes of America's most popular sport and examines his role as the preeminent "prima donna" wide receiver of his era, while catching up with Owens in present-day to see how he is evolving and discovering a new personal path forward.

title: Never Dies
overview: Amidst imminent financial ruin, a debt-ridden man experiences profound relief upon discovering his estranged late father’s substantial life insurance policy—only to be thrown into an absurd moral crisis when the patriarch unexpectedly resuscitates inside the hearse en route to the funeral home.

title: The Beachnickers 3
overview: Rocha decides to foot the bill for his daughter's wedding in an island and invites his loyal colleagues, Alexandre, Lima, and Diguinho, along with their families, to the all-expenses-paid celebration. The setting seemed perfect for an unforgettable trip, but the peace is short-lived, soon giving way to a series of surprises and mishaps.

title: On Behalf of My Son
overview: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

title: BAGA: Tomorrow Belongs to No One
overview: In a conservative East Coast village, two young lovers struggle to escape poverty and tradition when an unexpected pregnancy pushes them into difficult choices, leading one to turn to drug trafficking in a desperate bid for a better future.

title: Kommissar Jennerwein – Hochsaison
overview: Jennerwein has barely started his job in Garmisch-Partenkirchen when a Danish ski jumper falls to his death, the president of the Winter Games Committee narrowly escapes an assassination attempt, and anonymous letters announce further crimes. Amidst suspicious villagers and vain local politics, Jennerwein must unmask a perpetrator who craves attention and is playing a deadly serious game.

title: Einar Schleef - No Germany Did I Find
overview: With his monumental productions, Einar Schleef pushed theatre to the outer reaches, confounded expectations in East and West alike, grappled with GDR origins and the BRD present. A universal artist emerges from the archive: “I’m not human, I’m dynamite”.

title: Se domani non torno
overview: It follows the tragic life of Giulia Cecchettin, starting from the private pain of her father, Gino Cecchettin, and culminating in a cinematic story that stems from the book of the victim's father, entitled Dear Giulia.

title: The Guest
overview: At a luxury seaside hotel, Karl and Emilie are preparing for their son’s naming party, when Karl’s estranged mother, Vibeke, suddenly turns up uninvited. Karl want’s her gone, but his sister, Rikke, insists there won’t be any issues. Over one tense weekend, old patterns and buried wounds surface in front of in-laws and guests — until the celebration fractures into a collision.

title: Grin
overview: While visiting her family, Eva is introduced to her mother’s new partner, Lucian. When the group play Lucian’s mysterious old board game for the first time, they begin to believe it has summoned a demonic entity that punishes those who have committed terrible sins. After a series of terrifying encounters, the players begin going missing one by one. Eva soon realizes the game is more deadly than she could ever have imagined.

title: La Esquina tá en Candela
overview: When a man bursts into a grocery store armed and demanding to talk with somebody, an ordinary afternoon turns into chaos in the neighborhood.

title: Codes
overview: Following a major attack on British soil, a politician discovers the only way of saving his country is by killing the man in front of him.

title: Lorie Party 2026 au cinéma
overview: Lorie invites you to a colorful and festive evening! Hear all her greatest hits during her Lorie Party 2025/2026 tour!

title: Putri, Jangan Gentayangan Lagi
overview: Putri had run away from home about a year prior. When she was finally found by her mother, Mak Elli, and her younger sister, Alana, Putri was ill following childbirth; she had originally fled after becoming pregnant by her boyfriend. Mak Elli insisted that Putri and her baby, Raman, return home to reunite with the family. After moving back, however, Putri’s condition deteriorated, and she passed away. Since then, local residents have complained about sightings of Putri’s wandering spirit, which appears to be lingering as if there is unfinished business.

title: Idling
overview: When Frank’s car breaks down in a bleak winter landscape, a mechanic named Barry comes to his aid. Hoping to repair the car, the two men take it into a labyrinthine underground parking garage governed by strange rules, where other unfortunate souls seem trapped.

title: Snowbody Like You
overview: A holiday first date ends in a frosty misunderstanding, leaving Peyton and Ethan to go their separate ways. Years later, a Christmas blizzard brings them back together, giving them one more chance to discover if the magic between them was meant to last.

title: Married to the Filipino Mafia
overview: Meet the Filipino Mafia Family.  “Blood is thicker than water. We’re happy to spill yours.”  Marrying into this family? Good luck.

title: Crystal Apple: Unforeseen Consequences
overview: Psychic spies/jazz fusion artists Angelica Apple and Crystal Floredeliza go undercover as escorts to investigate the sale of alien technology.

title: Black Cab
overview: Harry, a third-generation cab driver in London, struggles to find his place and purpose in a fast-changing world.

title: De souche
overview: As immigration becomes more central than ever in political discourses, De souche offers a dizzying deep dive into the far-reaching tentacles of the “Great Replacement” conspiracy theory, which is gaining popularity across the Western world. In this illuminating documentary, journalist and filmmaker Simon Coutu travels across Québec and France, meeting a range of people who subscribe to or specialize in the subject. He examines the origins of this rhetoric, its harmful consequences, and its ties to the far right and white supremacist movements. A hard-hitting documentary that offers an essential critical perspective.

title: Rambut Sewu: Satu Langkah Getih
overview: Wulan moves to a village with her mother, Ratih. After working at a tea factory, they move into an old house owned by the company. From then on, Wulan begins to experience strange dreams and mysterious events, eventually losing control of herself. The villagers attribute these disturbances to Marni, a former resident of the house whose story has remained a mystery for decades. When Wulan’s story spreads on social media, Damar, a reporter and native son of the village, arrives to investigate. Suradi, who is aware of the powers of the past, comes to help. Together, they try to sever Wulan’s connection to Marni and the power of Dhandhang Gendhing.

title: Block 10
overview: In early 1943, at the Auschwitz main camp, hundreds of Jewish women are confined in cramped quarters in BLOCK 10, which is separated from the rest of the camp grounds. Nazi doctors subject them to the most painful methods of forced sterilization. Prisoner doctors are forced to collaborate. The Jewish gynecologist Dr. Maximilian Samuel is blackmailed with the gassing of his 20-year-old daughter if he refuses to participate in the brutal experiments. Caught in this moral dilemma, he seeks his own path.

title: Celeste & the Cyan Sun
overview: On her last day in Italy, a young woman finds herself swept away by a new intimate friendship towards reckless abandon and tragic circumstances.

title: Drei Kameradinnen
overview: Hani, Kasih and Saya have shared a deep friendship since their youth. Now, after years, the three meet again. But no matter where they are, it becomes clear time and again that everyday racism affects their lives. Nonetheless, their friendship gives them strength. Until one dramatic night shakes everything up.

title: Daffy Season
overview: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

title: I Play Rocky
overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

title: Jimmy
overview: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

title: Disco
overview: An ordinary man undergoes a transformation as he enters the dark and dangerous world of the underworld.

title: Mookuthi Amman 2
overview: A queen sacrifices herself to protect her son, the prince, from invading enemies.Mookuthi Amman returns to protect the child and confronts a mysterious woman who embodies a new and dangerous evil.

title: Fuego amigo
overview: Andrés is a veteran of the Malvinas War. He works at the family transportation company. News arrives that the EAAF?the Argentine Forensic Anthropology Team?has identified the remains of his friend Damián, who fell in battle. He has started smoking again. A delegation is being organized to travel to the Islands and attend the ceremony. An old pang of guilt torments him: when Damián fell, he was a few meters behind him, firing his weapon. He always knew it wasn?t him, but the specter of friendly fire casts a shadow over his memory.

title: The Liberation
overview: Rita is entranced by the mesmeric Leader and renounces her family to embrace the world of the enigmatic Harmonia commune. Her daughters Ella and Jo put everything on the line to infiltrate the cult and bring their mother home. Yet, once immersed in the commune, they find themselves inexorably drawn into the Leader’s labyrinthine web of psycho-spiritual manipulation.

title: Being Heumann
overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

title: The 12 Dates of Christmas
overview: Christina Walker, a successful shop owner who has devoted her energy to her career at the expense of her dating life, goes on 12 dates in the 12 weeks leading up to Christmas hoping to find Mr. Right.

title: Remember
overview: An estranged couple who have forgotten what it means to love each other find themselves pretending to be together again for the sake of their daughter, whose memory is fading.

title: Djinn Wedding
overview: When four estranged siblings reunite in their remote Anatolian village for their sister’s wedding, long-buried memories begin to resurface. As the celebrations unfold, two of them are drawn back into the unbreakable bond they once shared. Family secrets slowly come to light, leading them on a journey through grief and the invisible ties between generations.

title: Soul Patrol
overview: From deep behind enemy lines, a hidden chapter of American military history is uncovered, prompting the question of whether reckoning with the past can bring peace to those who lived it. The Vietnam War’s first Black special operations team reunites to tell their story.

title: Mouse
overview: When her closest friendship is suddenly disrupted the summer before senior year, a teenager struggles to find her footing and develops an unexpected, complicated bond with her best friend’s mother.

title: Gorgeous Grandmother
overview: An aged beautician longing for confidence joins a beauty pageant.

title: Panch Pandav
overview: Spanning from the Dwapara Yuga to the present Kali Yuga, Yudhishthira searches for his family in Nepal, where he confronts injustice, corruption, and oppression in a modern-day battle between righteousness and evil.

title: Summer Holidays
overview: A city boy's summer at his grandparents' Godavari village transforms when he befriends a spirited local paper boy. Together they explore rural life through adventures that forge an unforgettable childhood bond.

title: Littermates
overview: Amidst the chaos of a mysterious war, two victims of an attack take refuge at a cottage in the English countryside, where an enigmatic caretaker insists they cannot leave.

title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
overview: An amateur production of A Christmas Carol at a retirement home is reluctantly directed by reclusive man on community service.

title: Dance with the Jackals 8
overview: Having overcome various dangers together for years, the Jackals gang are trying to establish a new life when they are mysteriously kidnapped and find themselves on their way to Germany, right in the middle of a human trafficking network. In this absurd journey, orchestrated by Şerafettin Top Müller, the Jackals must confront their past grievances and survive within an international criminal organization they unknowingly became involved in.

title: Atop Babel's Tower
overview: One night, Pérez, a small insomniac rat, wakes up feeling uncomfortable. To find out what's disturbing his sleep, he must descend a towering mattress tower where his commune is sleeping peacefully, unaware of his nocturnal descent.

title: GROTESQQQUE
overview: Anthology film made up of three separate segments:  A(E)LIENS, YOROSHIKU★Girl, and NOCTURNE: NUIT GROTESQUE.

title: Nuisance Bear
overview: A polar bear is forced to navigate a human world of tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as its ancient migration collides with modern life. When a sacred predator is branded a nuisance, it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.

title: Avedon
overview: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon's archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

title: Au nord des hommes
overview: A group of journalists ventures deep into the Québec wilderness to investigate a camp offering a mysterious retreat for men. Behind the seductive rhetoric and apparent camaraderie lies a full-fledged radical cell: they might have walked straight into a very dangerous engine.

title: The One
overview: Hawk, a Native American ex-foster youth, who visits Enid, Oklahoma for the tallest Christmas tree lighting. He bonds with locals and runaway teen Alexis while dealing with PTSD, anxiety, and self-discovery concerning his faith.

title: Nooru Kodi Vaanavil
overview: Vino and Fenny's lives intertwine in a poignant tale of love, hope, and heartbreak.

title: Fiesta Pagäna
overview: The movie chronicles the untold story of the band from their origins in the 1980s, highlighting their rise to fame, creative tensions, line-up changes, internal dynamics, controversies, and fan culture.

title: Pegasus
overview: A DJ drifts through the spectacle of Miami nightlife, torn between the urge to create and the desire to be seen.

title: Blood Border: Cambodia's Second Killing Field
overview: During the war between the Khmer Rouge forces and the Kampuchean United Front for National Salvation in 1979, Channdy and his family flee Cambodia along with another thousands of Cambodian people, hoping to find safety in a third country. After seeking refuge in Thailand, they are promised a new journey to freedom but instead, they are taken to the remote Dangrek Mountains, where a terrifying ordeal begins.

title: Zi
overview: In Hong Kong, a young woman haunted by visions of her future self meets a stranger who changes the course of her night -- and possibly her life.

title: The Stationary Traveler
overview: Two filmmakers propose to Cristián Sánchez, a cult Chilean director, to make a film. The condition is that he resurrects the characters of his classic works, but in the form of zombies. He fights to protect his artistic principles but ends up trapped in his own film.

title: Merry Memories
overview: When her nephew is assigned a Christmas scrapbook project for his deployed mother, organized accountant Michaela is forced to partner with charming teacher Bryan to help bring the season to life. What begins as a carefully planned holiday checklist quickly turns into a string of heartfelt, unexpected adventures that draw them closer together. But with Bryan preparing to leave town after Christmas, Michaela must decide if she’s finally ready to let love disrupt her perfectly ordered life.

title: Kamen Rider Kabuto 20th: ​​The One Who Inherits the Heavens
overview: 20 years after the events of the series, humans and Worms are walking towards the path of coexistence. However, ZECT is secretly developing a new Masked Rider System. Yui Kagami, the son of Arata Kagami/Kamen Rider Gatack is qualified to use the new system. Arata Kagami also investigates a ZECT conspiracy all by himself, but a shadow of an unexpected person appears before him...!

title: Onwards and Sideways
overview: Tony Evans is the deputy head of a local primary school. Emma Dretzin is a pianist, composer and single mother of two daughters. Neither knows the other until a startling encounter changes the course of their lives: on the same morning, they are both confronted with a diagnosis of Parkinson’s.

title: American Baby
overview: A Filipino immigrant and her charismatic American husband, a casket salesman, share a life shaped by sacrifice and silence, as their child revisits the fragile promise of the American Dream inside the quiet fractures of their marriage.

title: Native Sin
overview: A Native American priest and his medicine woman sister must set aside old resentments to unite faith and tradition against a vengeful spirit.

title: What Lives in Room 214?
overview: "What Lives in Room 214?" is a psychological horror featurette that follows actor Cory King who moves into a hotel for semi-successful actors, producers, and directors. The longer he stays, the more he notices things around him have never been what they seemed. "What Lives in Room 214?" tells a cautionary tale about the cost of fame.

title: Home
overview: Where does the Ukrainian road home begin and where does it end? The poetic journey follows a Ukrainian actress, Yelyzaveta, who emigrated to Lithuania, traveling back to her homeland country ravaged by war. Will we reach the final destination? How to reach home? Relatives? How to get back to the past which no longer exists? Can we wake up from the dream?

title: Tumšā robeža
overview: A historical thriller about Latvia in 1938 - not long before the Russian occupation.

title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
overview: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

title: Bloody Men
overview: In 1980s Sweden, we follow a boy’s love for a mother who tries her best, all the bloody men who come and go, and about not becoming one yourself.

title: Molder Man
overview: Thrown into a shapeless prison, the Molder Man must face the music.

title: Annapurna: Dreams and Nightmares
overview: Annapurna: Dreams and Nightmares is a 2026 documentary film by Thin Air Cinematics that challenges the traditional "man-conquers-mountain" story by exploring high-altitude mountaineering through failure, fear and human obsession  Filmed over 13 years, spanning 6 expeditions on 5 different climbing routes, this deeply personal documentary is an unflinching exploration into the life and mind of a high-altitude climber.  What begins with a dream becomes obsession, and ultimately a reckoning with why we climb in the first place.

title: Pray for Us
overview: In the mid-to-late 1970s, two young women from different social backgrounds meet inside the Patronato de Protección a la Mujer (Women’s Protection Board), a state-backed institution that confined thousands of women, many single mothers, in convents and boarding schools under the guise of moral 'reform'. Ana, a rebellious 19-year-old from Barcelona, is sent by her wealthy father to a Patronato facility overseen by the merciless Sister Socorro. Amid the harsh conditions, Ana forms a deep bond with Sole, a friendship tested by escape attempts, reprisals, and an ultimate sacrifice.

title: The Black Pearl
overview: A young engineer's dream of becoming a fighter pilot for the Royal Moroccan Air Force is put on hold until he unravels the mystery of his missing parents.

title: The Invisible Guest
overview: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

title: Forever Mom
overview: Leonora is an overwhelmed mother of two young girls and an architect whose career has been put on hold. While her husband works all day, she carries the weight of raising their children and the quiet feeling that she has lost herself somewhere along the way. One afternoon, in the middle of her daughter?s birthday party, she drives away, leaving behind the noise and contradictions of motherhood.

title: The Romantics
overview: Liam returns to his hometown of Liverpool to reconnect with the memory of his long-missing sister, but an encounter with an old friend forces him to confront the grief he’s kept buried.

title: Little Genes
overview: In 1987, on a weekend camping trip in Utah's beautiful Wasatch Mountains, fourteen-year-old Arlo Murphy is eager to prove he can be a world explorer scout like his Dad, while his parents grapple with Arlo's gender identity.

title: Edo²
overview: With another summer drawing to a close in a province of Northern Italy, Edoardo fights to regain control of a youth that feels far too small for him. When an online site appears to truly get him, offering a way to fill his emptiness, Edo seizes the chance to break free from the suffocating fear of never being enough.

title: Apolonia
overview: Justyna, a young archaeologist conducting research on the graves of "cursed soldiers" - victims of crimes committed by the communist security apparatus - discovered in Pułtusk, must confront her own family's past.

title: Animal Justice
overview: Nick Morgan, a dedicated National Park Ranger, with a passion for wildlife takes a dark turn when he witnesses a brutal act of animal abuse. Nick embarks on a clandestine mission to protect these vulnerable creatures Will he find a way?

title: Infection
overview: An ambitious office worker suspects her boss’s mysterious illness may be contagious. With a promotion within reach, she faces a choice between professional advancement and the person she wants to remain.

title: The Agonist
overview: Sebastián was born with spasticity. Living with that discomfort, he films his life: his loves, friends, children and family. But as the years go by, the pain in his body becomes too much to bear, and the idea of risky brain surgery that could change him forever takes hold. Is that what he really wants? Is he ready to become someone else?

title: Holiday Unplugged
overview: Sally, an art teacher, has spent the last 10 years honoring the memory of her late husband, Jake, while raising their children, Keegan and Boo. Feeling like she’s finally ready for love, she joins a dating app and is matched with Damon, her former colleague who taught her kids’ kindergarten class. Jake had co-founded a web platform that preserved family home videos. When a server migration wipes out Sally’s treasured videos of him – and her phone containing backup copies accidentally shatters – the only hope is finding the original tapes. She doesn’t want Keegan and Boo to know about the missing videos so to buy time until they’re recovered, Sally institutes a screen-free Christmas for her family while secretly searching for the tapes.

title: ReLive
overview: A freak temporal anomaly erases her son from existence, a grieving mother is recruited for an impossible mission: travel back twenty years in her own timeline to a college hiking trip to kill the inventor of time travel to save her son.

title: Bye Bye
overview: Henry decided to end his life by hanging himself. He planned everything carefully, but miscalculated one thing: when he sat down to write his suicide note, he suddenly discovered that his pen had run out of ink.

title: Terra Firme
overview: In a coastal village forgotten by time, young Juca approaches Zé Cangulo, a fisherman living in isolation on his boat. A silent bond forms between them, shaped by waiting and the sea. By bringing to light a submerged past in which the boy recognizes himself, this encounter opens up the possibility of a fresh start.

title: Tiliche
overview: A Tiliche dancer from Oaxaca loses his colorful fabrics in an attempt to assimilate into the unfamiliar, gray world that surrounds him.

title: Weekend Warrior
overview: Tess goes to a Larp and transforms herself into the Elf General Tauriel. When her foot soldier is wounded in a fight with orcs she heals him with a magic balm, which gives the weekend war games an unexpected erotic turn.

title: Meet-Cute
overview: Jaded by endless dates, two anxious misfits decide to reveal everything – pet peeves, red flags and sexual dealbreakers – in a brutally honest encounter that might just become something more.

title: Monero
overview: A story based on true events and dedicated to the Mexican cartoonist RIUS.  In 1968 Mexico City, Mancha—a cartoonist for the magazine "La Garrapata"—battles government censorship of his work under Gustavo Díaz Ordaz, while one of his own cartoon characters manifests in the real world, urging him to be brave and fight for what he believes in.

title: Steadfast Woman
overview: This film centers on the ups and downs of an ordinary woman, Chunxia, chronicling her journey of growth — swept along by fate and healing herself amid suffering.

title: Résonance
overview: Lily, a young actress, loses her grip on reality when she discovers that her neighbor looks exactly like her—feature for feature.

title: blood & soil
overview: A young man attends a rally.

title: Argentina Stone
overview: Argentina Stone explores how The Rolling Stones inspired one of the most powerful urban subcultures in Latin America. Through archival footage and testimonies from key figures of Argentine rock, the film traces the birth, rise, and legacy of the rolinga movement - a tribe that transformed admiration for a band into a way of life.

title: Dead Net
overview: A promising young tennis player finds her dreams threatened when she is targeted by a mysterious figure who is out for her blood.

title: The Tunnel
overview: Suffering from post-traumatic stress after a violent assault in a tunnel, Janet Crane returns to the subterranean passageway to confront her fears and regain her freedom. When a hooded figure starts following her, the past and present collide as Janet tries to escape.

title: Christmas Pop-Up
overview: Desperate for a fresh start, an unlucky-in-love set decorator takes a job designing a Christmas Eve pop-up event for a jaded celebrity chef, hoping to escape her current hell - living with her ex and his new girlfriend - before they get engaged on New Year’s Eve.

title: It's Not Tomorrow Yet
overview: After her divorce, Lola tries to rebuild her life amidst raising her children and dealing with the pressures of those around her. An unexpected encounter leads her to explore long-held desires and understand that letting go can also be a way to start over again.

title: One Night in June
overview: One Night In June is a dark drama that introduces Lydia and John, as they face a crossroads in their relationship. Through lies, betrayal and vengeful rage they both commit acts they cannot un-do. John is left with an ultimatum that will change his and Lydia's life forever. This gripping short film confronts the nature of the human experience. Our mistakes, our choices, how they impact the ones we love, and the extreme consequences we face.

title: Wilder
overview: Reeling from the trauma of an abusive husband and father of her son, a mother has fearfully locked away and hidden any sense of it in the basement from her young son. Inevitably, when the boy suddenly discovers it, his juvenile and unguided spirit is tempted to set it free.

title: Perfume
overview: María Gabriela Epumer was a woman of innovative talent who created and performed rock music in the 1980s and 90s as a member of Viuda e Hijas de Roque Enroll, as Charly García's guitarist, and as a solo artist. Twenty years after her untimely death, Perfume access to 50 hours of footage she filmed herself?ranging from massive concerts to deeply intimate moments in recording studios and at home.

title: The Excrement
overview: This Documentary follows Detective Jessip as he hunts down Victor Valentine and his poop monster - "THE FILTH BORN"

title: Mog's Bad Thing
overview: Follows Mog, a tabby cat, who does a bad thing during a cat show hosted by her family in their garden, hides in the attic feeling sorry for herself, and must find a way to save the day.

title: A Season of Promises
overview: Heidi and Sophie are sisters who couldn't be more different – Heidi is buttoned-up and laser-focused on landing the play-by-play job for the local pro hockey team while Sophie is following her dream of making it in stand-up comedy while waitressing. Though a years-ago rift following their mother's passing has pulled the sisters apart, what they do share is a deep love for their father, Ed. When a fainting episode lands Ed in the hospital, Heidi and Sophie rush to his side. Hating seeing their father in that state – and still alone four years after losing their mother – the sisters decide to set aside their differences and team up to play Cupid at Christmas. As Heidi and Sophie work together to prepare Ed for the dating world in the hope he'll find someone special in time for the holiday, they each go on their own journeys that bring them unexpected joy, love and peace for Christmas.

title: Don't Forget the Sunshine
overview: After six years in Germany, Maria gradually loses touch with who she is, trapped between the routine of her work and the intensity of her nights in the techno scene. When her ailing mother and older brother come to visit from Greece for the first time, old wounds reopen and long-suppressed conflicts rise to the surface. Caught between her life in the Ruhr region and her ties to Thessaloniki, Maria is forced to confront her family’s past and search for her own identity.

title: Change of Heart
overview: Maia lives with her grandmother, Nora, on the family’s conventional cattle farm, which she will be taking over. After a devastating storm, Maia’s livelihood is questioned by her eco-minded neighbors and an anxiety is ignited in her, as she starts to grasp the disturbing scale of climate change. Maia must navigate between acting against the dire future of the planet and staying true to her heritage. Maia Against the World is a heartfelt and humorous drama about generational divides, eco-anxiety and cows.

title: Macumbaria
overview: The mystical element plays an unusual role in the civilizing process of Brazilian society. Realms such as samba, malandragem, soccer, and Carnival reflect this process, which unfolded in the shadow of the Precarious. On the street, in the terreiro, at the bar, in the favela, at the crossroads, or on the floodplain—a multifaceted historical and cultural identity was forged, resulting from the intersection of Amerindian and African spiritualities and European popular Catholicism. Macumbaria explores the phenomenon of the “macumba complex” through the lens of historian Luiz Antonio Simas, the film’s narrator.

title: Reflected
overview: A man wakes up and slowly discovers he is trapped in a mirror world.

title: A Chardonnay for Love
overview: When small-town writer Samantha Lane lands a career-making assignment to profile Maple Creek's local winemaker and most eligible bachelor, William Crew, her dream of moving to New York is tested by a deeper story.

title: Ethical Witchery
overview: Witches, Dahlia and Ivy, have been performing the same ritual for over five centuries. To spice things up, Ivy invites baby witch, Oleander, to join them, but Dahlia is not sure she's ready to change her routine.

title: The Wedding Bangles
overview: Argentina, 1967. On her fifteenth birthday, María mourns the end of her childhood while glimpsing an unfulfilling future as a middle-class woman. Tension escalates when her older cousin Bárbara pushes her to the breaking point.

title: Solo Vivo
overview: A profound narrative about the history, resistance, and social impact of the Ecological Farmers Market (FAE) of Porto Alegre, RS. A sensitive look at the dignity of rural work, resilience in the face of climate extremes, and the strength of a community united by respect for the land to nurture human relationships and promote health through healthy eating.

title: The Sweetest Christmas Date
overview: When overworked chiropractor Charlotte Hope receives an exquisite, anonymous Christmas chocolate, her orderly world is suddenly turned upside down. Determined to uncover the sender, she teams up with Cody Woods, the charming but guarded chocolatier whose shop is fighting to survive the holiday rush. As their search leads them through festive small-town magic, Charlotte discovers that the sweetest surprises – and maybe even love – can’t be scheduled, controlled, or ignored.

title: Irreparable
overview: Alice has something to tell her sister Olivia; Olivia is buying some very sharp knives – she has a few things to take care of at home. They soon start talking about love and Olivia's husband (or perhaps ex-husband), Garcia. One of them needs to put on the brakes before they do something irreparable.

title: The making of Vincent - Dreams, Monsters & Independent Film
overview: Go behind the scenes of Vincent, the multi award-winning supernatural dark fantasy, and discover the creative vision, artistic collaboration and challenges of bringing an independent film about friendship, loneliness and monsters to life.

title: School Girls; Or, The African Mean Girls Play
overview: Becoming Miss Ghana 1986 would mean fame, fortune, and prosperity. At least, that’s what Paulina—the queen bee of Aburi Girls Boarding School—believes. When the pageant recruiter comes to school, Paulina and her crew pull out all the stops. But to their surprise, a new transfer student from America kicks the competition into a higher, far more personal gear.

title: Ebenezer
overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

title: How to Rob a Bank
overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

title: Victorian Psycho
overview: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

title: Madden
overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

title: Confession
overview: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

title: Carnaval
overview: Four friends from Brabant who live for Carnaval see their party plans unravel when one of them suddenly has to care for his estranged daughter and Prince Carnaval reveals a sinister side. They must do everything they can to save Carnaval.

title: Villeneuve: The Rise of a Champion
overview: Showcases the early years of Québec racing driver Gilles Villeneuve.

title: The Gospel of Christmas
overview: A struggling pastor moves his family to a troubled New York neighborhood, where they must save a neglected church from foreclosure before Christmas.

title: CRCL9
overview: An American woman studying in Europe who has been targeted by an online stalking game. As the situation becomes increasingly dangerous, she starts playing the game herself in an attempt to outwit her stalker.

title: Il faut brûler maman
overview: A comedy of manners set in a funeral home.

title: KICK
overview: American runner Nikki Hiltz is on the brink of triumph, steps away from achieving the ultimate goal of representing the US in the Olympic Games. As Nikki approaches this career milestone, they reconcile their identity as a trans nonbinary athlete in a fraught political atmosphere.

title: Hadota
overview: It revolves around a dramatic character who blends comedy and human situations, where Helmy plays the role of a man who lost his parents early and was raised by others.

title: Our Revolution
overview: He is exuberant, loud, and charismatic. She is courageous, delicate, and warm. Jacek and Grażyna Kuroń are utterly in love and convinced that together they can change the world. They give up their privacy to dedicate their lives to the fight for freedom. Their apartment becomes the "headquarters" of the opposition; a meeting place for people willing to risk everything in the name of a better tomorrow.

title: Never Surrender
overview: An ex-soldier and his grandchildren battle against ruthless criminals in a remote village. To survive, they must also confront their fears and regrets.

title: Under Fire
overview: As a fire captain in Idaho, Rob has spent his life saving others. Now, with the help of an experimental therapy, he may just learn how to save himself.

title: La Gran Sangre: ojo x ojo
overview: Two decades later, Tony Blades, Mandril, and El Dragón are released from prison to confront a mafia controlling the Rímac district. In a Lima plagued by extortion and contract killings, the iconic vigilante group returns without a shred of mercy, ready to fight crime by their own rules.

title: Identitti
overview: A student named Nivedita finds an old photo of her professor and discovers the latter had been living a lie. Saraswati, of all people — a woman of color who lectures on cultural identity — is in fact white. While the media and online community whip up a frenzy, Nivedita faces a political and personal dilemma as she tries to find out Saraswati's motive.

title: Forest
overview: Two Muscovites go on a trip to Karelia and disappear without a trace in an endless, dense forest. Each attempt to get out turns into a new threat. The forest seems to breathe, watch and does not want to let go... It becomes clear: the Forest lives by its own rules, which there is no time to understand - without food and water, the girls will not last long. In the meantime, one strange family moves into an abandoned village house. Strangers are not welcome here. After all, they used to live in the Forest.

title: A Bowl of Chicken Noodles Before I Die
overview: If today were your last day, what one small thing would you really want to do?  For Ale, the answer is simple: enjoy a bowl of his favorite chicken noodles before he truly gives up on life. But when his regular food cart is closed, that situation leads him into a series of unexpected encounters.

title: Eternal Return
overview: Cass has come to a personal point of emotional invulnerability, until she meets Virgil, a cartographer. Along with his partner Malcolm, they attempt to travel back in time to awaken Cass to love again.

title: Lagi Probation: Kerja Ngejar Apa Sih?
overview: Driven by family duty, a desperate young woman lands a competitive probation spot at a corporate seasoning giant, only to find her newly formed workplace friendships shattered when it is revealed that six ambitious interns must battle it out for a single permanent position.

title: Allen
overview: 20 years after his encounter with an alien, Petey never moved on. Now his old friend has returned, and the reason why is complicated — and unexpected.

title: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
overview: Eager to get off Santa's naughty list, Snoopy goes all out to be the nicest beagle in town.

title: Stand Up
overview: Vera is a fun-loving 23-year-old until her entire life is upended after an accident leaves her in a wheelchair. Struggling to cope with her new reality, she meets Xander, who helps to show her that being in a wheelchair doesn’t mean she’s stuck.

title: The Christmas Switch
overview: Craving a change of pace, work-hard-play-hard city girl Freddie swaps lives with her homebody sister Mattie at Christmas time, only to unwrap a whole new kind of mess.

title: ¿Dónde está la casa de mi padre?
Spirit Tasting
overview: On New Year's Eve, three former punks toast their late bandmate at a distillery. When a strange sommelier invites them to a top-shelf tasting, the trio discover there's only one catch: every bottle requires a 'wish'. But as each of their desires twist into doom, these old friends discover that every pour at the Red Bat Distillery comes at a deadly price.

title: The Best Summer of My Life
overview: Brother and sister, teenagers Savva and Aglaya, live in the city and do what they like most. Savva is a fan of computer games and an eternal fidget. Aglaya is a young genius of science who dreams of making an important discovery. Each has plans for the summer holidays: Savva is going to a games festival, and Aglaya is working on a project at a science camp. But one day, their plans fall apart. Since the guys are always teasing each other, arguing about everything and can't agree on anything, one day a disaster occurs, as a result of which their apartment is simultaneously flooded with water and engulfed in fire. As punishment, the parents send the children to the village to their grandparents. For Savva and Aglaya, this is a nightmare: they are used to food delivery, entertainment, games and the Internet, and in the village they have to get up early, work in the garden, feed for slaughter, go to the bathhouse and a bunch of other village "delights".

title: How Could I Live Without You? 2
overview: The members of Kuplung are getting ready for a wedding.

title: The Serpent Spirit Goddess
overview: Dedi, a man who is bankrupt and deep in debt, performs a ritual to marry a beautiful jinn named Dewi in order to get the money to pay off his debts—with one condition: he must never marry anyone else.  As Dedi grows richer and more prosperous, he suddenly falls in love with a woman and intends to marry her. Dewi becomes furious because Dedi has forgotten the condition of the ritual, and eventually, a series of terrifying events threatens the lives of those closest to Dedi.

title: Chekhov in Rosario
overview: Two actresses and a director meet in an old theater in Rosario to rehearse scenes from The Seagull and The Cherry Orchard by Anton Chekhov. As rehearsals unfold, the line between fiction and life begins to blur. Chekhov?s words merge with memories, frustrations, desires, and questions about time, loss, and the need to keep making art.

title: A Royal Stables Christmas
overview: At a prestigious equestrian training center, Ella forms a connection with a charming horseman who understands her desire to escape family expectations and forge her own path. But when his surprising royal secret is revealed, Ella must decide whether their Christmas romance can overcome the obstacles standing between them.

title: The War We Carry
overview: Hninn is a diligent student who wants to become a nun. In February 2021, the military seizes power in Myanmar and everything she has strived for vanishes overnight. Civil war breaks out in the country and Hnin's family must learn to live with constant fear: moving house, going into hiding, deciding who to trust and where to go at all. For six years, the camera follows them as they search for a safe place in a country torn apart. And yet, amidst all this horror, there is still room for faith, courage and even joy.

title: Paper Tiger
overview: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

title: Agent Zeta
overview: Four Spanish ex-intelligence officers are assassinated simultaneously worldwide. The CNI discovers all participated in the covert "Operation Ciénaga" decades ago in Colombia. Zeta, the CNI's best operative, must hunt and protect the sole survivor, facing his deadliest global mission yet. Top Colombian agent Alfa will join Zeta, seemingly knowing more about "Ciénaga"'s secrets than him.

title: Five Figurines
overview: Five Figurines is a Nigerian feature film directed by Akay Mason that will be released in cinemas nationwide on November 13, 2026.

title: Plucked
overview: In Gilded Age New York, a rebellious woman plans to divorce her emotionally unstable husband. Consequently, a polite and civilized evening violently spirals into pandemonium. Some things never change-until they do.

title: Sour Grapes
overview: When her husband skips couples' therapy, Justine is left face-to-face with his over prepared personal assistant instead.

title: Lex Julia
overview: Julia travels to her new friend Anna's private island and meets Anna's husband JP, whom she recognises from a past traumatic encounter.

title: Dear Ajayi
overview: In 1990s Nigeria, two estranged sisters forced to live under the same roof while caring for their paralysed mother navigate grief, ambition, love, and the fragile bonds of family.

title: Heartland
overview: A former country star, Misty Jones, comes out of seclusion to investigate the disappearance of her missing niece, a rising country musician and must grapple with her own past and Nashville’s seedy underbelly. Her search uncovers a murky side of Nashville where no one, including Misty, is who they seem.

title: Itllu Arjuna
overview: A mute man with exceptional skills falls in love, proving that true feelings do not always need words.

title: Body Works
overview: A laid-off dishwasher finds survival in a paid romance until the relationship begins to demand more than a transaction.

title: God with Us
overview: In an urban Maryland neighborhood, virginal Mary Anne Thomas and her boyfriend Joseph 'Junie' Love find their lives turned upside down when Mary discovers she’s miraculously pregnant without ever being with a man. As disbelief, danger, and divine destiny converge, their love is tested in a community desperate for hope.

title: The Child
overview: The story of Mariaje and Nicasio, the mother and grandfather of one of the children who died in a gas explosion in a town in the Basque Country in October 1980. On a journey marked by unexpected emotions, Mariaje and Nicasio search for - and find - their own unique way to overcome their loss.

title: Holy Light
overview: A child and his father journey from their Romanian mountain village to an airport to collect a light for their village church.

title: DIRT
overview: Following the outbreak of war, an elderly Ukrainian refugee gets stopped by Customs while trying to bring a jar of Ukrainian soil into the UK.

title: Donga Naa Koduku
overview: A young man with a compulsive stealing habit brings trouble upon his family, who must deal with the consequences of his actions.

title: Axis of Life
overview: A pilgrimage in which a spiritual master must choose one of his disciples as his successor turns into an inner journey for each of the participants. Who am I? Where do I come from? What is left, when I am no longer here? A mystic tale about the path of the human soul through eternity.

title: Mrigaya 1.5: The Hunt Continues
overview: Officer-in-Charge Debanjan Dutta of the Kolkata Police and his team face mounting danger while investigating a gruesome crime that shakes their neighborhood. As twists derail the probe, a ruthless gang spreads chaos across the city. With tensions rising and violence erupting, the hunt intensifies.

title: All the Lovers in the Night
overview: Freelance proofreader Fuyuko's carefully ordered life in solitude begins to transform after meeting Mitsutsuka, a quiet high school physics teacher.

title: Prima Facie
overview: Tessa is a brilliant British defence barrister dominating London’s ruthless courtrooms. Fierce, witty, and self-made, she defends men accused of sexual assault — until she is assaulted herself by a colleague from a powerful legal dynasty.  Suddenly, the system she trusted turns against her. As she faces the same tactics she once used in court, Tessa’s faith in justice unravels. Once in control, now exposed and disbelieved, she must fight to reclaim her voice and sense of self.

title: Badgeless
overview: Sergeant Jalil is a recently retired police officer. In his new civilian life, he starts working as a security guard for a company, but he misses his former life. One night during a night shift, two thieves try to break in. Jalil shoots them with his non regulation firearm, wounding one of the young men. The police, his former colleagues, search for the culprit. Jalil tries to kill the wounded thief, but the police set a trap for him.

title: Eight Walls Two Doors
overview: As lockdown protests erupt in China in 2022, past and present blend for a Chinese woman living in New York; all the while, a leaky radiator sparks a romance between her husband and an older neighbor…

title: The Loneliest Man in Town
overview: Blues musician Al Cook lives in an apartment filled with memories. Outside, the world carries on without him. But when his home is slated for demolition, out of the ruins of his existence, a long-forgotten dream suddenly resurfaces.

title: Drink Coffee, Talk Fast
overview: Cast, crew, and fans trace the making of Gilmore Girls and the enduring pull of Stars Hollow, revealing how its stories shaped lives and connected generations.

title: The Mayor: Halsema & Amsterdam
overview: Amsterdam mayor Femke Halsema was followed for a year by filmmaker Mijke de Jong, from crisis meetings to television interviews and from public appearances to closed-door sessions, as the right to protest clashed with public safety.

title: Ashland
overview: Shot on S16mm over the course of 8 years, ASHLAND examines the hopes and dreams of young people, horse whisperers, Indigenous elders, and mystics, all living today in the sacred lands of Eastern Montana.

title: L'Autre
overview: Bedridden following a severe cancer, a man sees his recovery falter when his young roommate begins to stir up his deepest fears.

title: Night Vision
overview: Jenny is a young filmmaker searching for inspiration. She falls in love and tells her crush she cannot remember her dreams. Jenny enjoys browsing markets and buys an old video camera at a flea market. She explores the footage on the camera's tape, revealing strange artifacts and surprising presences. What was that appearing on the screen?

title: A Proud Family Wizmas
overview: When Penny Proud’s rant about Wizmas and the commercialization of Christmas causes Santa to quit on Christmas eve, Penny finds herself guilted into putting on the red suit and replacing him. And in the process of delivering Yuletide cheer with the help of Santa’s irreverent elves, she discovers that indeed the Christmas spirit is still alive.

title: Known Strangers
overview: Three former classmates unexpectedly run into each other during a diner robbery. An awkward reunion between a criminal, a police officer, and a diner employee, as they are faced with the different life paths that have led them there.

title: A Job Well Done
overview: In a gritty neighborhood of Geneva, a double-decker bus becomes a refuge where social workers guide refugees through the labyrinth of Swiss asylum laws. On the frontlines of a Kafkaesque struggle, they face ethical dilemmas where compassion clashes with rigid regulations. As frustration turns into determination, solidarity edges closer to illegality, raising a crucial question: when does empathy become a "crime of compassion"?

title: Pop Pop
overview: Dustin and Dibz are best pals; they survived their senior year of college, and their future looks bright. They share an apartment, an internet series, and the dream of finding their place in an uncertain landscape, navigating male fragility and identity crisis. The challenges of messy adult manhood are fully open to them.

title: White as Salt
overview: Turkey's shimmering Tuz Lake, the country's second-largest lake, supplies 70% of its salt, even as its waters recede due to climate change. Here villagers still harvest pure, untreated salt. For widower Salih, salt is more than a livelihood – it's survival. Before dawn, he rides out on his loyal horse Fedai with his daughter Zeliş, gathering salt at sunrise and sharing the harvest with neighbours. But when Salih's friend Muhtar yields to the mayor's orders and a greedy corporation claims the lake's salt rights, villagers are barred from the shore and threatened with losing their horses. Salih refuses to give in. He makes forbidden journeys, devises schemes to outwit the ever-watchful gendarmes, and relies on his honest heart and loyal accomplices.

title: Beautiful Birds
overview: When a widowed birdwatcher reluctantly teams up with her granddaughter for a local birdwatching competition on an island in Scotland, their search for rare species becomes a heartfelt journey through grief, love, and letting go.

title: Oblivion
overview: A young sex worker, Maria, sets out to reconnect with her estranged biological father, but their growing relationship takes an unexpected turn as she conceals her true identity, forcing her to confront the delicate line between deception and healing.

title: Bahía Honda
overview: Laboring in a Cuban ship graveyard, an almost apocalyptic world of fire and creaking sheets of steel, Pitufo dreams of a better life. An atmospheric, magical glimpse into a life on society's margins.

title: The Neighbourhood is Changing: Revisiting Mulberry Street
overview: In 2005, a group of up-and-coming filmmakers based in Lower Manhattan set out to make an independent horror film called Mulberry Street, in which a virus turns ordinary New Yorkers into rat people. 20 years later, they reflect on the making of the film and what it has to say about the evolution of New York City.

title: Girl and Wolf
overview: "Girl and Wolf" is an animated feature film for a young adult public based on the Roc Espinet's homonymous graphic novel. It tells the story of Paula, an innocent girl who lives in a medieval village attacked by wolves. Paula will have to face dark childhood traumas, soulless hunters, magical wild spirits and an ancient pack of wolves.

title: A Match for Mr. Christmas
overview: A no-nonsense PR executive Lori agrees to help a charmingly irresponsible toy empire heir Emmett find love and prove he’s the right man to take over the company when his father retires – all by Christmas. But after a string of hilariously failed dates, she discovers the perfect match might be the one she never planned on: herself.

title: KILL/SAVE
overview: In a locked-down megacity where reality is optional, a lonely programmer risks his mind to rescue his girlfriend from a virtual prison — only to face a truth that challenges the very meaning of salvation and free will.

title: Cadence
overview: Cadence, an elite runner, discovers how far she will go to succeed. Subjected to a corrupt experiment that harvests adrenaline from her nightmares to enhance her performance, she faces an impossible choice when her dream is threatened: her sport or her morality.

title: The Sweetness of Bitter Things
overview: In rural Macedonia, Dora, a middle-aged doctor, has built her life around duty – to her distant husband, troubled daughter, and ailing mother. When an injured young woman is brought into her home, caring for her awakens a desire Dora has suppressed for decades. Their growing intimacy becomes a secret affair, slowly destabilising the life she has worked so hard to preserve.

title: Montpellier
overview: In the year 1721, Sebastià Calaf, a mercenary grayed by war, tracketh a ravenous beast alongside his nephew Jaume, knowing not what foul horror awaiteth their steps.

title: Intolerant
overview: Paula is a designer who tries to go on with a busy morning. However, her day takes an unexpected turn when a mistake at the coffee shop sets  off a chain reaction, triggering strange behaviours in everyone around her.

title: Second Chance Holiday
overview: Dating expert Chelsey (Ayesha Curry) is determined to break her so-called “curse” of always getting dumped during the holiday season. But when fate reunites her with her high school flame (Matthew Daddario), she wonders if her bad luck might just be the universe’s way of leading her back to her first love.

title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

title: Guarding Stars
overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

title: The Matriarch
overview: Seventeen-year-old Kim lives with her emotionally distant mother, mute younger brother, and strangers hiding in a secret room in their apartment at the Baltic coast. Vietnamese migrants regularly pass through their home as her mother, a key figure in a criminal network, runs human trafficking operations. When her mother's associate Luc defects to start a rival operation, Kim seizes her chance to prove herself to her mother. She navigates her first romance while entering a clandestine family business. As her good intentions drag her into a dark and brutal underworld that contradicts her sensitive nature, Kim begins to question the true costs of earning respect by crossing her own boundaries.

title: Status: Rejected
overview: Longing for love and the promise of a better life, a grandmother finds herself swept into an unexpected online romance that challenges her sense of worth, family, and the dreams she refuses to let go of.

title: Snow in June
overview: A man unexpectedly meets his first love — a woman who died in a car accident three years earlier. Realising the past and present have become intertwined, he takes her on an impossible journey across Mongolia.

title: Enjoy Your Stay
overview: To avoid losing custody of her six-year-old daughter in Manila, Luz, an undocumented Filipina cleaner working in a luxury Swiss ski resort, must earn money at any cost – even if it means transgressing her own moral limits.

title: Andoy
overview: A surprise birthday celebration turns into a waking nightmare when an enigmatic clown transforms a gathering of old friends into a series of disturbing performances, forcing each of them to confront the darkest truths they've hidden from one another.

title: V. Shantaram
overview: Chronicles Shantaram Rajaram Vankudre, aka V. Shantaram, on his remarkable journey from the silent era through the advent of sound and colour, showcasing his evolution as one of India’s most influential filmmakers.

title: Heysel 85
overview: When 39 people are killed prior to the European Cup at the Brussels Heysel stadium in 1985, the mayor's daughter and an Italian journalist are torn between their professional assignments, family, and human nature.

title: Sh*t Happens
overview: When their nine-year-old daughter falls mysteriously ill, a wealthy Dominican couple turns to an experimental treatment created from their housemaid Liddy's feces, without her knowledge. Once Liddy and her colleague Dominga discover the truth, they seize the opportunity to turn the household’s power dynamics upside down.

title: Dark Noon
overview: Caught in a cycle of petty crime and imprisonment, a man is released from prison for a failed bank robbery attempt while an impending solar eclipse offers a way out of the cycle.

title: Agnes & Amir
overview: Amir is 28, gay and has just fled from Iran. Agnes is 101 and still too young for a retirement home - she thinks. The two move in together - and save each other's lives.

title: Josephine
overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

title: Fogaréu
overview: On the border between the real and the fantastic, between the colonial past and the overwhelming modernity of agribusiness, the city of Goiás is the scene of the meeting between the young Fernanda and her secret roots. She returns to the home of her wealthy uncle, after the death of her adoptive mother, in order to implode the certainties and to reveal the painful truth about its origin.

title: Date Night
overview: As Moira prepares for her anniversary dinner, her fond memories of true love put the romance back in necromancy.

title: Hamka: Awal Mula Vol. 3
overview: Set against the backdrop of West Sumatra, a passionate young rebel clashes with his strict scholar father, prompting a self-funded pilgrimage to Mecca where he discovers his destiny to reform Indonesian Islam and finds the love of his life.

title: Peretera Maneta
overview: This film chronicles the journey of a sophisticated young schoolteacher whose city upbringing contrasts greatly with her new-found environment. Her reluctance to form relationships with other villagers takes a turn as she discovers a friendship in the place she never expected: with her students. With little time remaining during her placement at a village school, it is up to her to reveal the shocking discovery she has made. But will local folks believe this arrogant city woman?

title: The Body in the Locker
overview: When Amy, the CEO of a major charity, loses her father, she's shocked to discover he owned a mysterious storage locker with a deadly secret inside - the body of a woman. Was her father a murderer? Who was this woman?

title: Ah Girl
overview: In 1994 Singapore, a perceptive seven-year-old girl navigating the aftermath of her parents' marital dissolution faces a severe existential crisis when her erratic, estranged mother offers an unstable proposal for custody, permanently altering the child's perception of domestic normalcy.

title: ENE Repeat
overview: A close-knit group of friends embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.

title: The Man Who Could Have Changed the World
overview: Based upon the true story of Ranuccio Bandinelli, an antifascist Archaeology and History of Art teacher who sought to steer clear of politics but who found himself appointed, ex-officio, as Hitler and Mussolini’s official guide during their visit to Rome and Florence.

title: The Kolotun and the Magic Kingdom
overview: The Snegirev family is preparing to celebrate the New Year together for the last time, after which Anfisa and Igor will tell their son Roma about the divorce.

title: Gropiusstadt Supernova
overview: Berlin-Gropiusstadt, a prefabricated housing estate on the outskirts of the city. On the last day of the year, three young people are at a turning point: Tarik receives a letter about his impending deportation, Stella gets accepted to an acting school abroad, and Luan wakes up from a nightmare in which he is left behind by both of them.

title: Spinoza
overview: In 1656 Amsterdam, young Jewish philosopher Bento de Spinoza watches his world collapse when his closest friend is executed for printing forbidden ideas. The city is gripped by plague, fear, and religious zeal, and Bento's growing habit of questioning sacred truths makes him a danger to both Church and synagogue. Amid this turmoil, he meets Rembrandt van Rijn, the once-celebrated painter now sliding into debt and disgrace.
